criteriaZh: 选定一个现实场景（通勤、走廊、自习室均可），用一分钟做静默观察。
写下：看到什么、可能意味着什么、若需上报会怎么说（三句以内）。
不编造戏剧冲突；强调清晰、可复核。
criteriaEn: Pick a real scene (commute, hallway, study room). Observe silently for one minute.
Write: what you saw, what it might mean, how you would report it (≤3 sentences).
No drama — clarity and verifiability only.

criteriaZh: 在日常环境里指出两处「掩蔽」（挡视线）与一处「掩护」（挡冲击/挡意外）的类比物。
各用一句话说明为什么，以及移动时如何利用。
criteriaEn: In a daily setting, name two concealment analogies and one cover analogy.
One sentence each on why, and how you would move using them.

criteriaZh: 写一条你给小队用的简短口令格式（挑战—应答），不超过两行。
列出两条「禁止在公开频道说」的信息类型（位置细节、完整计划等）。
criteriaEn: Write a short challenge–reply passphrase format for a small team (≤2 lines).
List two info types forbidden on an open channel (exact location, full plan, etc.).

criteriaZh: 针对「被突然点名/被盯上」的日常类比，写疏散或降低暴露的三步（短句）。
强调分散、降低可识别性，不要写攻击性对策。
criteriaEn: Using a daily analogy for sudden attention, write three short steps to disperse or reduce exposure.
Focus on dispersal and lower signature — no aggressive countermeasures.

criteriaZh: 用「情况—位置（模糊）—行动/需求」格式写一条不超过 40 字的短报。
删掉一切形容词堆砌，只留可执行信息。
criteriaEn: Write a ≤40-word report: situation — rough location — action/need.
Strip adjectives; keep only actionable facts.

criteriaZh: 列出四条你今日可执行的「冗余/检查」习惯（装备类比：钥匙、电源、资料备份等）。
每条一句话，说明失败代价。
criteriaEn: List four check/redundancy habits you can do today (keys, power, file backup analogies).
One sentence each on failure cost.
